answer.answer: No, counts from different mesh sizes aren't directly comparable because smaller particles are undercounted by coarser nets; the conversion factor scales roughly with the inverse mesh ratio, giving an upper-end factor of about 1.5x (0.333/0.300) to adjust the 0.333 mm count toward the 0.300 mm window. This factor is approximate and depends on the particle size distribution of the sampled microplastics.
